canonical.title: Privacy & Data Minimization Engine
canonical.job: Determines which data is necessary, optional, sensitive, derived, prohibited, retained, or deletable.
canonical.bWeb: A bloated intake shrinks to its justified minimum.

rules: A collected field needs a bounded purpose.
Necessary and sensitive fields need a written necessity basis.
Sensitive fields require an active purpose-specific permission record inherited from Build 023.
Optional and prohibited data fail the minimized state while collected.
Derived data needs source fields and derivation logic.
Every collected field needs a bounded retention period, deletion trigger, and applicable redaction rule.
boundaries: Deterministic product-control demonstration, not a legal compliance determination.
Synthetic browser-local fixture; do not enter personal data.
